_comment: [CMS: solution] One page per platform at /solutions/<slug>. 'modules' is optional (only Cubix has them). 'hardwareUsed' lists product names that exist in content/products.json — the solution page cross-links to those real hardware pages automatically by matching name.
name: Cubix
summary: A comprehensive warehouse management system that gives real-time inventory visibility, ensuring accurate stock tracking from goods-in to dispatch.
description: CUBIX is a comprehensive warehouse management software designed to streamline inventory control, optimize warehouse operations, and enhance productivity. It offers real-time inventory tracking, multi-location support, and flexible reporting, ensuring efficient and accurate management of all warehouse activities.
features: Real-Time Inventory Management
CUBIX offers accurate, instant stock tracking across warehouses.
Multi Location
CUBIX ensures seamless inventory management across multiple stores/warehouses.
Multi-Currency Capability
CUBIX enables smooth international transactions with flexible rate options.
modules: This module allows for the creation and acceptance of purchase orders, viewing of pending orders, and order cancellations. Additionally, it provides easy access to opening stocks, purchase returns, and requests.
This module handles the business aspects related to customers, including quotations, sales orders, and customer orders.
Items can be sold through direct sales, challans, and credit transactions. Additionally, it includes a comprehensive dispatch process.
This module handles mobility operations, including location shifting and item transfers. It also verifies items after they are picked up and dropped off.
Current stock levels for any item can be viewed, including package information and package type.

name: Activ
summary: Live visibility of assets and stock using RFID and barcode, so you always know what you have, where it is, and where it has been.
description: Activ gives real-time visibility of assets and stock using RFID and barcode technology, so teams always know what they have, where it is, and where it has been.
features: Real-time RFID asset tracking
Know the exact location and status of every tagged asset.
Stock counts in minutes
Replace manual counting with fast RFID/barcode sweeps.
Movement history & alerts
Every move is logged, with alerts for anomalies.

name: Trackline
summary: Comprehensive asset management software that streamlines tracking, maintenance and lifecycle management using advanced RFID and barcode data.
description: Trackline is a comprehensive asset management software specifically designed to streamline the tracking, maintenance, and lifecycle management of company assets across various industries. The software leverages advanced barcode and RFID technology to capture and maintain detailed information about each asset, from initial procurement to deployment at specific sites or branches.
features: Detailed Asset Tracking
Manage workforce anywhere, anytime for maximum flexibility and productivity.
Procurement Integration
Seamlessly integrates corporate functions, streamlining workflow and increasing efficiency.
Service Agreement Management
Effortlessly track performance and gain insights with intuitive tools.

name: On Service
summary: OnService empowers service providers with streamlined hardware repair and maintenance solutions, minimizing downtime and boosting productivity.
description: OnService empowers service providers worldwide with streamlined hardware repair and maintenance solutions. Simplifying workforce management from routine to emergency tasks, it ensures smooth operations, minimizes downtime, and boosts productivity. Real-time monitoring, automated reminders, and detailed employee reporting enable teams to proactively manage challenges and optimize performance, fostering stronger client relationships.
features: Ease in managing workforce
Ensure flexibility and productivity with anytime, anywhere management capabilities.
Work Integration
Streamline operations across functions for enhanced workflow efficiency and cohesion.
Project Cost Analysis
Effortlessly track performance, gain insights, and foster continuous improvement.
